name: central-pedidos
description: Live FIAP: central de pedidos usada para ensinar o harness em volta da IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.validar: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
